item.title: Public input sought on St. Mary's hazard mitigation plan
item.description: The Review/Bill Decker Chris Rippetoe of the Stephenson Disaster Management Institute speaks Tuesday at a meeting of local officials at the Parish Courthouse. Work is beginning on a new five-year plan for mitigating the effects of natural disasters. FRANKLIN — St. Mary Parish is once more working to get a handle on the risks posed by natural disasters and what can be done to reduce the damage.
